text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I swing by a diner after training and
happen to
find Light Hello there. She's
eating a hamburger
while looking at
some notes.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Taste, adequate. Arrangement,
adequate. Ease of
consumption... a little
troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But having it all pleasantly
arranged on
one plate does create a
strong impression...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, hello, Trainer. What a coincidence
meeting
you here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was the idea, but I've
managed to turn
my meal into work
too...
choice_data_list: Are you eating while you work?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When planning events, I often have the
chance to
manage food collaborations.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I developed a habit of
taking
notes on any impressive
restaurants or dishes I
come across.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's nothing that grand! I just find
it fun to
brainstorm, that's all.
choice_data_list: You're very dedicated to your work.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
But since you're here, Trainer, would it
be okay if
I picked your brain? Let's
see...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
What kind of food do you prefer to eat
while
watching a race?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. A lot of vigorous cheering is sure
to make
anyone hungry!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That means size is important... But
ideally you
should be able to hold it in
one hand... I'd also
like it to be typical
of other collaboration foods...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry about that! I got lost in my
thoughts for
a second. It's a bad habit of
mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In spite of her apology, Light Hello
continues to
diligently take notes. She
really is a passionate
worker.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I see, desserts are certainly enticing!
And not to
mention a perfect fit for a
sunny day.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hm, a colorful arrangement would make
even
ordering one a joy in and of itself...
Hehe, you
just gave me a wonderful
idea!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
As thanks, I'll let you in on a tip. The
soft-serve
ice cream here is especially
scrumptious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello giggles mischievously, and
the two of
us decide to enjoy some ice
cream together.
